# UI API 5 workbench example

This example replaces the Shell and session input while using the public conversation and workbench views. It composes the separate functional example through `app.footer` and Composer outlets. `Paper Studio` and `Observatory` demonstrate light, dark, narrow and reduced-motion Skin variants, with packaged backgrounds, decoration and typography.

Build with `synergy-plugin build`, pack with `synergy-plugin pack`, and preview with `synergy-plugin preview`. Approve the plugin, then choose **Studio** and a Skin in Settings → General. Add the functional example to the same isolated host to exercise cross-plugin composition. `?safe-ui=1` restores the default UI before third-party components load.

Inter is copied without modification from the repository's UI font asset. Its [upstream source and SIL Open Font License](https://github.com/rsms/inter) are preserved in `assets/Inter-LICENSE.txt` and the packed artifact. The SVG textures and decoration are local fixture artwork.
